templates.name: Create outer walls and slab on floors 2 and 3
templates.description: Creates 8 outer walls + 12 slabs on floors 2 and 3, bottom-up ("walls of the floor, then slabs of the floor"). Wall data is measured from the current AC file (thickness 0.3m; floor 2 height 3.0m, floor 3 height 4.0m); slab data comes from the same source (4 slabs on floor 2, 8 on floor 3, including the 4 high/roof-level ones). Slab reference level is corrected to the top surface relative to the home story (0→0.10, 3→3.10). Every step is self-contained with coordinates, no GUID dependency, portable across projects. dryRun=false creates directly.

plan.userIntent: Replicate the source file outer walls and slabs on floors 2/3 of the current project: walls of the floor first, then its slabs, ordered bottom-up by story and slab top level.

templates.notes: Creation-based template: build the outer shell on floors 2/3 using CreateWall x4 + CreateSlab x1 per floor. Parameters come from measured ground-floor geometry (GetElementGeometry); each step is self-contained with coordinates, no GUID dependency, works across projects. Consistent with tpl-starter-room-walls (4 CreateWall) and tpl-starter-scan-structure (CreateSlab). Replaced the previous "copy" template because CopyElements with empty sourceGuids is blocked at three layers (resolver / schema minItems / C++ NO_SOURCE_GUIDS).
